specificationName: Correct MCP Tool Name and Parameters

componentsUpdated.changeMade: Fixed MCP tool name from 'post_activity_result' to 'metabob_post_activity_result', changed parameter name from 'activityId' to 'activity_id', removed invalid 'backend' parameter
componentsUpdated.reason: Primary enforcement change - no ripple updates needed as interface (ActivityExecutionData) already uses snake_case naming

before.behavior: Tool call with wrong name 'post_activity_result', MCP server returns 'Tool not found', silent failure, no metrics recorded
before.dataFlow: OpenCode → MCP Client → MCP Server (Tool not found) → Silent failure
before.impact: Learning system disabled, Thompson Sampling not operational

after.behavior: Tool call with correct name 'metabob_post_activity_result', MCP server finds tool, metrics recorded to database
after.dataFlow: OpenCode → MCP Client → MCP Server → metabob-cli → RPC API → Database
after.impact: Learning system operational, Thompson Sampling updating parameters

blastRadiusAnalysis.reason: All callers use ActivityExecutionData interface which already matches fixed parameter names
